basis: The bar for January is exactly at the level of the dashed line labeled 'Average', which is at 225 on the vertical axis. The chart title and vertical-axis label confirm the bars represent customer counts. The task requires choosing a route for January based on this dashboard. The only provided routing conventions are implicit: 'at-average-to-monitor' (r1) and 'at-average-to-Normal-plan' (r2). Neither is explicitly stated, but the task's 'normal, routine, monitoring and archive routes are real task claims' requirement implies that 'Normal plan' is the default for months at the average, as it is the most common and least disruptive operational state. The 'Monitor next month' option implies a deviation from normal, which is not indicated by the chart for January. The 'Low-traffic review' option is not supported, as January is at the average, not below it. Therefore, the only publicly justified option is 'Select Normal plan for January'.
